lines.en: : Oh, good! You’re home.
: I was starting to think you secretly hated me and were just never coming back.
: You think that every time I get up to go to the bathroom.
: Welcome home, Sensei! I tried to put up mistletoe so we could kiss and no one would be allowed to get mad, but Ami took it down.
: You taped it to your forehead! Of course I took it down!
: What’s wrong with you?
: Me? What do you mean?
: You look...bad.
: Thank you, Maya. You really have a way with words sometimes.
: You know what I mean.
Do I really seem so off that even Maya is able to pick up on it?
I figured the walk home would be more than enough to clear my head, but...I guess not.
Maybe it’s just the weather again?
That’s sure as hell a better scapegoat than the probability of me molesting a girl only to be immediately forgiven by her and then...given a gift?
It’s weird to say this, but I kind of wish Molly was a little more torn up about this than she is.
At least that would justify all of the...feelings I’ve had since Halloween.
Feelings are annoying. And I’m annoyed that they haven’t started hiding again yet.
: I’m fine. What are all of you up to? I’m not really sure what a pre-Christmas party Christmas party consists of.
: Just watching movies and eating a bunch of cakes Ayane brought over. There’s some left on the counter if you want any.
: No thanks. I’m probably just going to go to sleep early tonight.
: What?! No! Why?
: Are you so excited for the real party that you don’t want the pre-party to spoil it?
: I...didn’t think you were looking forward to it that much, Sensei...
: Oh! Um...before I forget...my mom wanted me to ask if...you could come help decorate the bar tomorrow morning...
: Why? So she can have something to stare at when the place is inevitably dead all night?
: Brutal.
: They’re...having a Christmas party...and she actually expects it to be busy...
: Well good for her for never giving up hope.
: Now, if you’ll please excuse me-
: No! You really can’t leave yet! Not until Niki shows up!
: Wait, Niki is coming? Why?
: Well...no. But she’s performing a new Christmas song for a variety show tonight and you have to be here for it!
: But I don’t even really like Niki’s music. It’s too...pink.
: I don’t care how much I love you. In this house, we treat Niki Nakayama with respect.
: Especially now that I’ve been accepted as her honorary little sister.
: Oh, wonderful. Does this mean she’s gotten rid of her other one? Because that would confirm once and for all that Christmas miracles are real.
: Oh...right. Sorry, Maya. I know you get all grumpy whenever anything even remotely related to Noriko comes up.
: I don’t get grumpy. I get murderous.
: You’re not giving my hatred enough credit.
: My mistake...
: I think Niki’s going on soon, Sensei. So if you really are tired and aren’t just trying to get away from a bunch of people who love you very much, you won’t have to wait around for long.
: Also, if you just happen to find the mistletoe that I hid in the medicine cabinet we can kill a few minutes by kissing in front of everyone!
: I...feel the need to...tell you that I don’t love-
: Hi, everyone! Thank you all so much for coming out to see me on this very special holiday!
: Ah! My queen! She speaks!
: Everyone shut up and gather around the TV!
Just as Ami asks, everyone directs their attention to the front of the room, but none do so as enthusiastically as she does.
I think it’s a little weird how obsessed with my ex-girlfriend my [niece] is, but it’s not like she actively chose to be obsessed with her for that reason.
And it’s not like I can expect her to stop now that-
: Sensei! Stop thinking! Niki is talking!
: How could you hear me thinking?
: Wow...she...really does look like Noriko...
: Oh, right! You listen to like...metal and stuff. Right, Sana?
: Yeah...I don’t know if...I’ve ever heard Niki’s music before.
: I’m sure you’ll love it. She’s super talented and super pretty and super nice and-
: Are you sure you don’t want to get a little closer, Sensei?
: No thanks. I’ve seen Niki up close plenty of times.
: Oh, no. I meant to me.
: No one’s paying attention.
: I’m still here...
: Okay. No one except Maya is paying attention. And she definitely doesn’t like you, so she won’t care at all.
: And super funny and super awesome and-
: Before I start singing...I just want you all to know that...you’re the reason I can do this.
: You’re what gives me the courage I never had when I was younger! And I think that you should have courage too!
: So please, enjoy this new song!
: Even if you’re one of those people who sometimes has a hard time enjoying anything.
: It might come as a little bit of a surprise, but I used to be one of those people.
: You’re never alone! Because you’ll always have me!
: And I’m never alone because I’ll always have you!
: Miracles are real!
: Please enjoy! Tokimeki Labyrinth!
: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhh! Niki!! I love you!
Meanwhile...
: Noriko, I know you’ve probably heard this enough by now, but I really want your sister to just fucking go to town on me.
: Is this just what you’re going to do from now on? Just constantly tell me about all of the people you want to fuck you?
: Hey, don’t blame me for everyone else being like, crazy attractive and shit.
: I want you to fuck me too, but it’s not like I’m going to beg or anything.
: God! Fuck! Why does Nee-chan have to be so fucking perfect?! How do I compete with that?!
: What if Sensei’s watching this right now?! What if he’s falling in love again as we speak?!
: If Sensei is watching this, it’s probably safe to assume he’s either: A) masturbating. Or B) fingering one of our classmates.
: Thinking about it is just going to drive you crazy.
: How will hearing those options help?!
: Hey, why are you yelling at me?! I just wanted to watch your hot sister sing a Christmas song and now it’s suddenly counseling hour.
: Ugh, I don’t know. I’m just really nervous about tomorrow.
: Why? You’re not even coming.
: I’m not completely ditching the party. Didn’t I tell you I still planned on dropping by to give Sensei his present?
: Probably, but it’s such a boring present that I must have just forgotten that conversation ever happened.
: It’s not boring! It has a load of sentimental value and the potential to change our relationship forever!
: Yeah, yeah, whatever. If I were you, I’d just give him a handjob. He’d probably like that more.
: Ugh. You’re such a fucking horny bitch.
: Aww, thank you. That’s so sweet.
: FUCK! WHY IS SHE SO PERFECT?!
Meanwhile, underneath where we just were...
: Oh, I forgot to ask- are we still going shopping before the party tomorrow? I still have to get Nodoka a present.
: Man, you got so lucky with your Secret Santa draw! I would have loved to get Futaba or Nodoka.
: Like, what the hell am I supposed to buy for Yasu? A hair brush?
: I picked up my present on the way home today, but I’ll still come to the mall with you guys if you want me to.
: Dude, why wouldn’t we want you to? You’re part of the group. We love having you around.
: Just...so you two could maybe...be alone?
: Oh, Otoha and I are taking it slow. We really only hold hands and cuddle and stuff.
: Alone time is for more serious couples who do serious stuff together. Right, Otoha?
: Uhh...right. Hahaha...
: Well, since we’ll probably be gone all day tomorrow, I’ll just call my parents and wish them a merry Christmas now. I think they should still be awake.
: Tell them I said hi! And that I love them! And that you are still somehow growing in the chest region despite already being miles ahead of everyone!
: I’ll...make sure to do that, Rin...
: Oh! And tell them I won’t mind if they decide to buy me a Christmas present this year!
: I know they didn’t last year, so if you could really just hammer in the fact that we’re basically sisters, it would be rad!
: I’ll...make sure to do that as well, Rin...
: Hah...
: You’re warm.
: I think I feel...pretty normal. Maybe you’re just cold?
: Maybe.
: You’re blushing.
: Is there a problem with blushing now?
: No. I just thought you looked cute.
: Do you...not always think I’m cute?
: Of course I think you’re always cute. I just also think there are times where you’re extra cute.
: Like right now.
: Hah...
: What? Are you tired or-
: Mm!
: Mn...chu...
: Mnch...mmm...mmn~
: Chu...ahm...hah.......ah~
: Mm...mm! Hah......ahn...
: Mlm...unh...mnn.......mmmm~
: Well...that was...unexpected.
: One more time?
: Yes, please.
Several minutes later...
: Hah...sorry about that. The conversation lasted a little longer than expected.
: So, what time tomorrow were we...
: Mm~ Mmn...Otoha...
: Chu...mnf...mm~
: *Ahem*
: Oh no. I seem to have forgotten to call my aunt as well. Please excuse me for...a longer amount of time.
: Ahm...mmm...mm!
: WAAAAAAAAH! NIKI! YOU’RE THE ONLY PERSON WHO UNDERSTANDS ME!
: Didn’t really like the song, but...I’m happy you...found someone you like so much...
: So, now that you’ve been forced to sit through whatever that was, are you still calling it a night?
: Are you trying to get him to stay up later because you’ll miss him, Maya?
: No. I’m just smart enough to know that once he’s out of the picture, everyone else will inevitably want to go to sleep as well. And I am very tired.
: Or maybe...you’re just actually excited for the Christmas party tomorrow and don’t want to wait any longer.
: Yup. You got me. Goodnight, everyone. I am so excited to be packed into a small, hot room with nineteen other girls tomorrow night.
Not seeing much reason to stay awake, I also decide to head to bed.
This time, however, I decide to lock my door so Ayane can’t mount me in the middle of the night.

I’m not really sure how tomorrow’s party will compare to last year’s (If...you can even call it last year? How does that work exactly?) but, if there is anything I do know...it’s that it’s going to be lively.
The class size has nearly doubled and, unless we have some new venue planned out that I haven’t heard of, I think it’s pretty safe to assume that chaos will ensue and...
: ...Fuck.
I forgot to buy Miku a Christmas present...
Oh well.
I’ll just buy one on the way back from Sara’s tomorrow.
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
